QUESTION - SHOULD THESE BE PALLETIZED OR DELIVERED BACK TO YOU AS SINGLE CYLINDERS? 

NORMALLY THE VENDOR PICKS UP AND RETURNS THE CO2 CYLINDERS AS SINGLE CYLINDERS, THEY ARE LOADED ONTO THE TRUCK ONE AT A TIME AND THEN STRAPPED INTO PLACE. IF THEY ARE PALLETIZED UPON RETURN WE CAN ALSO ACCOMMODATE THAT.
